page.layout: One page of text, single column of dictionary entries with Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac words; running head at top with page number at top right.

main_text.p: cisio, sententia: Circumcisio: Abscisio, מִחוּלְתָּא Abscisionem circumcisionis, h. e. abscissam particulam praeputii, Exod.4.26. Jon. Plur. גְּזִירָן, גְּזִירָתָא, & masc. גְּזִירִין Esth.1.19.

גְּזִירָא, גְּזֵרָא Ch. Segmentum, pars: Hinc etiam dicitur de Grege minuto & exiguo; & sic Syr. ܓܙܪܐ Grex pusillus, minutus, Lucae 12.32. Plur. גְּזִירִין Chald. Partes, 1.Reg.3.25. Greges parvi, exigui, 1.Reg.10.27.
גְּזִירְתָא Ch. Idem, Exod.4.26.27. in Jon. Targ. Hierof. habet גְּזִירְתָא. Cum Aff. מִן כֵּיב גְּזִירְתְּהוֹן Ex dolore circumcisionis ipsorum, Genes.34.25. in Jon.
ܓܙܝܪܬܐ Syr. Insula, sic dicta, quod à continenti sit quasi Decisa.
גְּזִירִין Chald. Harufpices, Dan.2.27. emph. גְּזִירָא Daniel.4.4.
מְגֻזְרָא Ch. Serra, vel Securis. Plur. מְגֻזְרִין, מְגֻזְרֵי 2.Samuel.12.31.
גָּחַךְ Ch. & Syr. Ridere, deridere, irridere, illudere. Pahel גַּחֵךְ Idem.
גֻּחְכָּא, גֻּחְכָּא Ch. Risus, derisio, irrisio, Prov.14.13. Psal. 79.4. Syr. ܓܚܟܐ Et risus vester, Jac.4.9.
גָּחַן Ch. Inclinare, Incurvare se, procidere, procumbere. Pahel גַּחֵן Idem. Syr. ܓܚܢ, quod suo loco.
גְּטַ Ch. Libellus, Scheda, גִּטִּין: Libellus dimissionum, repudii, divortii, Eccles.7.27.

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac words are transcribed approximately from the scan; vowel points and some Syriac forms are uncertain and may contain errors. The final word at lower right appears to be a catchword in Hebrew.
